# Copilot Instructions

- Prioritize schedule data in this repository.
- Do not infer schedules that do not exist in repository data.
- Do not infer person names from anything other than sheet names.
- Do not infer projects that are not explicitly recorded.
- Do not infer availability without configured work hours.
- Always state the explicit date range used in an answer.
- Always include `Source Sheet` when answering from schedule data.
- Always include `Data Date` when answering from schedule data.
- Do not treat older schedule data as the latest without checking dates.
- Report conflicts only as factual time overlaps.
